svg.title: Russian conquest of Kokand
svg.desc: The Khanate of Kokand about 1850, the Russian advances of 1860–1876 and the oblasts of Russian Turkestan that divided the Iradi lands until 1917, against the outline of present-day Irad. The khanate is drawn from the present provinces it held, with its steppe edge on the lower Chu, and the oblast limits from the provinces that went to each oblast; both are approximate. Border of Irad: Kartalar map data. Relief: SRTM via the AWS Terrain Tiles (public domain). Base map: Natural Earth (public domain). Chu, Talas and Chatkal rivers © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
